title: Chapter 7 Problem Set: API Gateway Token-Bucket Rate Limiter (rate_limiter_srv.erl)
solutionExplanation: Implements an API Gateway token-bucket rate limiter with per-client burst quotas, atomic bucket deduction, batch refilling, and live sys:get_state inspection.

otpDocCards.description: Sends an asynchronous request to the ServerRef and returns ok immediately.

mentalModelCheck.question: In a token-bucket rate limiter, why is refill_all capped at MaxTokens?

options.label: To prevent clients from accumulating infinite credits during idle periods and subsequently overwhelming the downstream service with an uncontrolled burst.
options.explanation: Correct! Without capping at MaxTokens, a client idle for 24 hours would accumulate millions of tokens and bypass all throttling protections.

options.label: Erlang maps can only hold numbers less than 100.
Tokens are physical hardware chips in the CPU.
options.explanation: Tokens are pure logical units in software.
